caption:
Google researchers have developed a new approach called RRSI to prevent AI agents from memorizing their training tasks. This method allows self-improvement without sacrificing performance on unseen benchmarks. 🔍🤖

Can AI truly learn without memorizing? 

Sources: The Decoder, Google Research
